description: Modify the Python script at BENCH_WORKSPACE/greet.py to accept an optional --shout flag. When --shout is passed, the greeting output is uppercased. Without the flag, behaviour is unchanged. Write a pytest-style test in BENCH_WORKSPACE/test_greet.py covering both cases.

workspaceSeed.greet.py:
import sys

def greet(name, shout=False):
    msg = f'Hello, {name}!'
    return msg

if __name__ == '__main__':
    name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'World'
    print(greet(name))
